select.$description: v0.6 — Select inherits the input shell. This file declares only the listbox popover deltas (item height, item padding, item state colors). The trigger uses input.* tokens with a forced trailing chevron slot.

trigger.$description: The selected-value display row. Identical shape to input shell.

listbox.$description: The popover that opens beneath the trigger. Uses surface.popover + popover shadow.

minWidth.$description: 128 px — never narrower than the trigger.

padding.$description: Inner padding around the item list.

height.$description: 32 px — tighter than the trigger so the list reads dense.

indicator.$description: Checkmark glyph color for the selected item.
